stimulus.text: Biologist Mara Okafor studies how prairie plants respond to drought. Rather than wilting uniformly, some species ______ their resources, shutting down growth in older leaves while keeping new shoots alive.

stem: As used in the text, what does the word "husband" most nearly mean if it replaces the blank in a later edition that reads "husband their resources"?
rationale: "Husband" is used in its less common verbal sense of managing a resource economically; the plants conserve resources by sacrificing older leaves.
